newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Strike paralyses interbank trading in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Strike paralyses interbank trading in Bangladesh.

text.p: Transaction in interbank market remained almost paralysed on Sunday due to an opposition-led general strike, dealers said.
"There was virtually no dealing in foreign currency. There were few deals in call money at the late hour," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at Saturday's level at 7.0 to 7.5 percent.
The strike ended at 2 pm (8 GMT) amid sporadic clashes between opposition activists and police in Dhaka and other major cities.
The Bangladesh taka closed at 43.2850/2950 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday.
